findings.finding: Sscsrind is not implemented. Only CSR_SISELECT (0x150) and CSR_SIREG (0x151) are defined and labeled as AIA, not Sscsrind. Missing CSR definitions for sireg2 (0x152), sireg3 (0x153), sireg4 (0x155), sireg5 (0x156), sireg6 (0x157). No Sscsrind entry in hwcap.h, cpufeature.c, or extensions.yaml. No context-switch save/restore for siselect/sireg in switch_to.h.

spec_citations.excerpt: Supervisor-level CSRs: siselect (0x150), sireg (0x151), sireg2 (0x152), sireg3 (0x153), sireg4 (0x155), sireg5 (0x156), sireg6 (0x157). Required if S-mode is implemented.

findings.finding: CSR_SIPH is defined at address 0x154, which under Sscsrind would be sireg4 (0x154 is reserved; sireg4 is 0x155). While 0x154 is actually miph under Smcsrind, the adjacent allocation (SIPH=0x154 next to sireg3=0x153 and sireg4=0x155) creates a future CSR number conflict risk if Sscsrind support is added.

spec_citations.excerpt: The mireg* CSR numbers are not consecutive because miph is CSR number 0x354.

findings.finding: Smcdeleg is not implemented. No RISCV_ISA_EXT_SMCDELEG macro, no mcdeleg CSR definition, no extension detection entry, no DT binding. The kernel has no counter-delegation infrastructure.
findings.snippet: (No Smcdeleg-related code exists anywhere in the kernel)

spec_citations.excerpt: Smcdeleg: Machine-level counter delegation. Encompasses all added CSRs and behavior modifications. Depends on Sscsrind. Must be implemented in tandem with Ssccfg.

findings.finding: Ssccfg is not implemented. No RISCV_ISA_EXT_SSCCFG macro, no scountinhibit CSR, no SSEPCFG envcfg bit definitions, no extension detection entry, no DT binding. The kernel has no supervisor counter-configuration infrastructure.
findings.snippet: (No Ssccfg-related code exists anywhere in the kernel)

spec_citations.excerpt: Ssccfg: Supervisor-level counter configuration. Provides access to delegated counters and new supervisor-level state (scountinhibit). Depends on Sscsrind. Must be implemented in tandem with Smcdeleg.
